proposed_widenings.name: passive family for ClassFeatureMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Danger Sense is always-on with no activation cost, no resource, and no reset cadence. The only current ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which mandates all three. A 'passive' family is needed for features that apply continuously as a property of the creature's state.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage variant for ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The current ClassFeatureEffect union is GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Danger Sense requires a 'modify_roll_advantage' effect scoped to a specific ability's saving throws. The v4 atom 'modify_roll_advantage' exists in the taxonomy but has no surface encoding in ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws

proposed_widenings.name: condition_suppressor on passive effects
proposed_widenings.justification: The advantage is suppressed when the creature has the Incapacitated condition. There is no surface type for condition-gated suppression of a passive effect. The v4 atom 'suppress' exists but no surface grammar for 'this effect is suppressed while condition X is active' on class features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: unless you have the Incapacitated condition

notes: Primary blocker is structural: no 'passive' family exists for ClassFeatureMechanics. The 'activation' family requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence, none of which apply to a permanent passive benefit. Secondary gaps: ClassFeatureEffect has no modify_roll_advantage variant, and there is no surface grammar for condition-based suppression of a passive effect. All three gaps would need to be resolved together to encode this unit honestly.
